title: A Gunner's First Primer
summary: Teaches a body-only beginner the stance, sponging, ramming, priming and firing sequence of one field gun.

title: Handbook of the Sponge and Rammer
summary: Drills the sponge, worm and rammer strokes of bore care for students who have only begun to harden the skin.

title: The Handspike Drill-Book
summary: Trains muscled students to traverse, wedge and shove a field gun by lever and shoulder alone.

title: Workbook of the Powder Cartridge
summary: Teaches tendon-hardened students to carry, judge and seat powder cartridges safely and keep sparks from the tub.

title: Primer on Laying the Bore
summary: Shows bone-stage students how to level the carriage and lay the bore on a mark by eye and wedge.

title: A Crewman's Book of the Trail and Limber
summary: Teaches a new qi circulator to hitch, steady and move a field gun with a little qi in the arms.

title: Canon of the Steady Vent
summary: Trains a Senior to keep the touch-hole clear, prime it cleanly and fire with a calm qi-steadied hand.

title: Handbook of Recoil and Run-Up
summary: Teaches a Senior to brake, brace against and run up a field gun through its recoil.

title: The Field Gun Reckoner
summary: Shows a Senior to range a mark by pace count, smoke and splash, then correct the next shot.

title: Primer on Round Shot and Wad
summary: Teaches a Senior to test iron balls, seat wad and shot firmly and skip a low shot over hard ground.
